text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Right at the start of the New Year, I 
stare intently at the documents in the 
Trainer's Room. Naturally, I'm thinking 
about Sakura Laurel's plan for this year.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It's not that I was dissatisfied with last 
year. Even so, looking back on it now, I 
can't help but think there was still more 
I could have done.
choice_data_list: Which is why this year, for sure...!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text: Good work, Trainer.
choice_data_list: Laurel? What's with that outfit...?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, does it suit me? Since it's New 
Year's, I decided to dress up a little.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
Thanks to that, I'm feeling refreshed and 
light on my feet! So with that said, want 
to go out for a bit?
choice_data_list: No, but right now...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
"Jeez, holed up in your room right at the 
start of the new year? You're always the 
one telling me to rest, Trainer!"

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
Come now, it's time for a change of pace 
with your cute trainee. Hurry up and grab 
your coat♪

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Following Sakura Laurel's invitation, I 
head over to a shopping mall bustling with 
the New Year crowd.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
Um, butter, flour, powdered sugar, eggs... 
where can I buy almond flour?
choice_data_list:
These look kind of like ingredients for 
sweets, but...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
Correct. Today, I thought I would try 
making some traditional French sweets♪

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
Actually, in France, we don't really have 
traditional New Year's dishes like Japan 
does.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
For things like Christmas where the family 
gathers, they seem to prepare lavish 
feasts, but—
choice_data_list:
Something this heavy right at New Year's 
is a bit much...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, isn't that so? So instead, I thought 
I'd treat you to some sweets unique to 
this season.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
"There is no whipped cream or fruit, and 
yet it's so beautiful and extravagant."
choice_data_list:
Hearing that... I'm actually getting a 
little excited

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
Leave it to me. I'll make something 
delicious for you!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
"A-Also, can we stop by the general store? 
That's the most important thing for me."

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, having free rein over the cafeteria 
kitchen... I'm truly grateful for winter 
break.
choice_data_list: Can I give you a hand?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
Let's see... Ah, I actually have some 
important missions ready! Please choose 
whichever one you like best from these.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Saying that, Sakura Laurel showed me a 
small ceramic figurine she had just bought 
at the general store.
choice_data_list: What are you going to use this for?
What are you going to use this for?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, that's a secret for now♪ Now then, 
now then, which one will you choose? 
There's the Eiffel Tower, the Arc de 
Triomphe, and even pink roses!
choice_data_list: Hmm... in that case, this one!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
――Now then, while we let the dough rest, 
shall we take a break as well?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
Waiting is an essential part of making 
sweets, too. If you don't let the dough 
rest, it might not rise properly, you 
know.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
So let's relax and wait too, sipping on 
some warm café au lait.
choice_data_list: It's not espresso?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
"Wow, you're quite knowledgeable! You're 
right, in France, coffee usually means 
espresso."

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
However, given your condition right now, 
Trainer, I thought this one would be 
gentler on your stomach. ...I'll make sure 
to add plenty of milk.
choice_data_list: ...Thank you.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
It's ready! Sakura Laurel's special 
"Galette des Rois"! Fufu, I think it 
turned out quite well, if I do say so 
myself.
choice_data_list: Yeah, that looks delicious!
Yeah, it looks so delicious!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
Now, a little piece of trivia before we 
eat. Inside this pastry, there is a small 
ceramic figurine called a "fève."

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
What happens if this figurine is in your 
slice of cake? Congratulations! You'll 
enjoy good fortune for the entire year.
choice_data_list: So that's why you prepared that doll!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
That's right♪ It's just a little fortune 
slip, but isn't it exciting?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
Now then, Trainer, I wonder which of us 
will draw good fortune today~?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (*Rattle-clatter—click!*)

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
—Hm? This texture... I knew it! It was 
inside mine!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
With this, all of this year's happiness 
belongs to me... doesn't it! Fufufu, I did 
it!
choice_data_list: Good for you, Mejiro Laurel!
Good for you, Laurel!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text: Yes! So... you don't need to worry.
choice_data_list: Huh? What do you mean, 'are you okay'?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
It's New Year's, so it's okay to take a 
relaxing break... isn't it?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
I know, you know. Even though it was your 
day off, you spent all morning glued to 
that data. ...All for my sake.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
Still, you don't need to push yourself 
that hard.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
Whether I go out with my trainee all 
dressed up, or take our time enjoying 
sweets together, this year, I am 
'completely fine.'

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
"Because I was the one who drew the lucky 
fève!"
choice_data_list: Laurel...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
Hey, Trainer-san. Do you know what design 
is drawn on this galette des rois?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
This is a bay laurel—a 'laurel' leaf. 
Laurel is said to be a symbol of victory, 
right? And drawing the fève from there—

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
"Doesn't this feel kinda like destiny? 
Maybe it means I can win every single race 
this year!"
choice_data_list:
If it's you, I'm sure even that's 
possible!
If it's you, surely even that is possible!
You're really so thoughtful...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
"Doesn't this feel kinda like destiny? 
Maybe it means I can win every single race 
this year!"
choice_data_list:
If it's you, I'm sure even that's 
possible!
If it's you, surely even that is possible!
You're really so thoughtful...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, isn't that right? So please don't 
worry, and enjoy the New Year to the 
fullest.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
There's a girl right here who's just dying 
to spend time with you, Trainer♪

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
Yes, she can actually do quite well when 
she puts her mind to it.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
So put aside all that thinking for later. 
Trainer-san, your job right now is to rest 
with all your might!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
Consideration? My, whatever do you mean? I 
simply wanted to spend New Year's with 
you, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
So, what shall we do next? New Year's is 
just getting started, so let's make sure 
to enjoy every bit of it♪
